# Interactive Video Branching Agent

This custom agent is optimized for creating interactive video experiences in HTML/JavaScript. It guides the user to:

- embed video players in web pages
- display choice buttons after video playback
- route button clicks to alternate video scenes or pages
- preserve an easy authoring workflow for branching stories

Use this agent for requests like:

- "Create a video scene with two buttons that choose the next video"
- "Make the play-along story where users pick wake up or set off alarm"
- "Implement branching video navigation in HTML"
